items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-05
items.q: His name was Johnny. Johnny something. He was the drummer. I had a little fellow from Los Angeles, California playing piano.

ctx.x: You don't know? I can't remember. They were New Orleans people?

No. One of the boys was from Springfield. His name was Johnny. Johnny something. He was the drummer. I had a little fellow from Los Angeles, California playing piano. I can't think of his name right off. But he was a wonderful piano player. He got his hands with Sue Lily. He had to take this hard paper like that and wrap it around his sandwich with rubber to make it sound. Rubber to make it make tense on the piano. The only way he can make tense on the piano.
